notes.title: Hardcore Modes Added!
notes.content:
Hardcore Modes Added!
1. Endless Hardcore mode now available!
2. Attack Hardcore mode now available!
3. New Leaderboard for Hardcore Attack mode!

tags.feature: 3. New Leaderboard for Hardcore Attack mode!

notes.title: Countdown Text Colors | Mobile Link Achievement!
notes.content:
Countdown Text Colors | Mobile Link Achievement!
1. Countdown text now changes colors on all levels!
2. Levels are now color coded by text color
3. Button added that links you to the Google Play Store mobile version of this game (Android only!)
